extension.news:
v1.0.3 - Clear Thumbnails is now Clear Cache Files - Pick exactly what to remove from a checklist, with the size of each item shown - Now also clears the TMDb Helper caches (blur, crop and database folders) - Thumbnails and Textures13.db are cleared together as one item, so artwork never goes blank - TMDb Helper caches are detected by name, so future versions are found automatically - Notifications, the Log Viewer and Clear Cache Files now use Kodi's own dialogs, so they follow the fonts, colours and layout of your skin - Log Viewer now uses a fixed width font and keeps the log's own indentation - Backups now leave out the TMDb Helper cache folders, so they are smaller and faster
v1.0.2 - Backup date and size now show in the item name (skins ignored the second label)
v1.0.1 - Added Delete Backup to the Restore Backup context menu (long press) - Backups now list newest first and show date and file size - Removed the irrelevant media context menu options from backup items - Restore Backup list no longer errors when the backup folder is missing
